title: ISO 4992-1:2020 — Steel castings — Ultrasonic testing — Part 1: General-purpose steel castings
locator: Ultrasonic testing of ferritic steel castings for general purposes, typically after grain-refining heat treatment, up to 600 mm wall thickness, using pulse-echo technique.
notes: 对象为铁素体钢铸件，不可直接套用于灰铸铁或球墨铸铁机床床身；更厚壁/特殊结构需要专门协议。
